seeds: fixture-000 … fixture-099 (the same seed drives every preset)

street.how_to_settle: each raise is its own single-call bet. Raise k (betType BID_k, amount = opening chip × a multiple the stage can reach; every amount factors into exactly one chip × multiple, which recovers the opener): u < outbid[k−1] → OUTBID, win = round(bet × refund) (refund 1: the bid comes back in full) and next names the following raise, whose increment is drawn from the derived stream SHA-256(seed|ladder|0) uniformly over steps[k−1] (in opener units): next.bid = round(opener × (multiple + step)); else v = (u − outbid[k−1]) / (1 − outbid[k−1]) and the locker pays the sloped band of v: win = round(bet × (payout + r·(2t − 1))), 0 in the empty band, with next = null since the auction is over. With edge "hammer" (default) every won locker has mean R × the hammer price and walks or outbids return exactly the stake, so the house takes 1 − R of what is bought and nothing else; raise k returns outbid + (1 − outbid) × R per unit staked. Edge "per-raise" instead solves the locker mean as (R − outbid) ÷ (1 − outbid) so every raise returns exactly R. The last stage has outbid 0: the rivals are gone and the locker always opens.
